question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To raise the wind
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To raise the wind"** means to obtain the necessary funds, usually for a specific purpose. (आवश्यक धन जुटाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He had **to raise the wind **to start his own business.
 
 
 
• **"To obtain the necessary funds"** refers to gathering or securing money needed for a particular task or project. (आवश्यक धन प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She managed** to obtain the necessary funds **through a bank loan.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given phrase is **'To obtain the necessary funds.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To teach mannerism **(शिष्टाचार सिखाना): Instructing someone on how to behave properly.

 
 
• **Example:** Parents often** teach mannerism **to their children from a young age.
 
 
 
• **To head an army **(एक सेना का नेतृत्व करना): To lead a military force.
 
 
• **Example:** The general was chosen **to head the army **in the upcoming battle.
 
 
 
• **To release one's frustration **(अपनी निराशा को दूर करना): To express or let go of pent-up emotions.
 
 
• **Example:** He went for a long run **to release his frustration** after a stressful day.
 
 

 

3a:Tb4b,

The correct answer is** Option 2)**
